intro: Christchurch's gym market has experienced significant growth since the post-quake rebuild, with City Fitness dominating the scene. With over 10 locations across the city, Kiwis have numerous options to choose from. However, with so many gyms to choose from, it can be overwhelming to decide which one is the best value for money.

sections.heading: Overview of Christchurch Gym Market
sections.body: The Christchurch gym market has seen a surge in new facilities and renovated existing ones, providing a wide range of options for gym-goers. City Fitness, Les Mills, and Jetts are some of the popular franchises with multiple locations across the city. With prices starting from $14.95 per week, there's something for every budget.

sections.heading: City Fitness Christchurch
sections.body: City Fitness has the largest presence in Christchurch, with 11 locations across the city. Their membership prices start from $19.95 per week, with a 12-month contract. They also offer a $29.95 per week option with no contract, providing more flexibility for members.

sections.heading: Post-Quake Rebuild of Facilities
sections.body: The rebuild of Christchurch's gym facilities has brought new and improved equipment, as well as expanded group fitness classes. Many gyms now offer specialized classes, such as yoga and Pilates, catering to a wider range of interests and fitness levels.
